elements.requirement: A creditor's petition must be in respect of one or more debts owed by the debtor.
elements.quote: A creditor’s petition must be in respect of one or more debts owed by the debtor

elements.requirement: The petitioning creditor or each of the petitioning creditors must be a person to whom the debt or at least one of the debts is owed.
elements.quote: the petitioning creditor or each of the petitioning creditors must be a person to whom the debt or (as the case may be) at least one of the debts is owed

elements.requirement: Subject to the next three sections, a creditor’s petition may be presented to the court in respect of a debt or debts only if the statutory conditions are met at the time the petition is presented.
elements.quote: Subject to the next three sections, a creditor’s petition may be presented to the court in respect of a debt or debts only if, at the time the petition is presented

elements.requirement: At the time a creditor's petition is presented, the amount of the debt, or the aggregate amount of the debts, must be equal to or exceed the bankruptcy level.
elements.quote: the amount of the debt, or the aggregate amount of the debts, is equal to or exceeds the bankruptcy level

elements.requirement: At the time a creditor's petition is presented, the debt or each of the debts must be unsecured and for a liquidated sum payable to one or more of the petitioning creditors either immediately or at some certain, future time.
elements.quote: the debt, or each of the debts, is for a liquidated sum payable to the petitioning creditor, or one or more of the petitioning creditors, either immediately or at some certain, future time, and is unsecured

elements.requirement: At the time a creditor's petition is presented, the debtor must appear either to be unable to pay the debt or each debt, or to have no reasonable prospect of being able to pay it.
elements.quote: the debt, or each of the debts, is a debt which the debtor appears either to be unable to pay or to have no reasonable prospect of being able to pay

elements.requirement: At the time a creditor's petition is presented, there must be no outstanding application to set aside a statutory demand served under section 268 in respect of the debt or any of the debts.
elements.quote: there is no outstanding application to set aside a statutory demand served (under section 268 below) in respect of the debt or any of the debts

elements.requirement: A debt is not to be treated as a debt for a liquidated sum for the purposes of subsection (2) solely because the amount of the debt is specified in a criminal bankruptcy order.
elements.quote: A debt is not to be regarded for the purposes of subsection (2) as a debt for a liquidated sum by reason only that the amount of the debt is specified in a criminal bankruptcy order

elements.requirement: The bankruptcy level is £5,000, unless another amount is substituted by the Secretary of State.
elements.quote: “The bankruptcy level” is £5,000

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State may by order in a statutory instrument substitute any specified amount for the bankruptcy level amount.
elements.quote: the Secretary of State may by order in a statutory instrument substitute any amount specified in the order for that amount

elements.requirement: An order substituting the bankruptcy level shall not be made unless a draft of the order has been laid before and approved by a resolution of each House of Parliament.
elements.quote: An order shall not be made under subsection (4) unless a draft of it has been laid before, and approved by a resolution of, each House of Parliament

minimum number of debts that must be owed to each petitioning creditor
thresholds.quote: at least one of the debts
